summary.headline: Behind target on orders (82.4%) and revenue (83.0%) this week, with YTD revenue also behind at 87.4% attainment and the required run-rate well above the current pace.

points.what: Orders fell 6.1% week over week, reaching only 82.4% of the weekly target.
points.so_what: This adds to the quarter's shortfall against target rather than closing it.

points.what: Revenue fell 9.1% week over week to 83.0% of the weekly target, a steeper drop than the 6.1% fall in orders.
points.so_what: Revenue fell faster than orders, meaning the weaker week came from smaller baskets rather than fewer orders alone.

points.what: Orders grew 44.4% year over year and revenue grew 37.3% year over year, both below the 75% growth the 2026 targets assume.
points.so_what: Growth at this rate falls short of the pace the targets were built on, consistent with the week landing behind target.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell 1.3 pp week over week to 14.8%, a notable improvement, and is also down 0.6 pp year over year.
points.so_what: Lower cancellations helped limit the revenue shortfall against target this week.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of Jan 26 rose 2.2 pp week over week to 11.6%, flagged as notable.
points.so_what: A jump of this size is a risk to watch in order quality over coming weeks.

points.what: AOV fell 4.7% week over week and 5.5% year over year to $83.71.
points.so_what: A falling AOV on top of falling orders adds pressure on hitting the revenue target.

points.what: The current 8-week revenue run-rate is $51,543, well below the $76,671 weekly run-rate required for the rest of the year to hit the full-year target.
points.so_what: This gap means the full-year target requires a meaningfully stronger pace than the last 8 weeks have shown.

points.what: Weekly orders reached 82.4% of target and revenue reached 83.0% of target, both behind for the week.
points.so_what: Neither KPI closed the gap to target this week, widening the shortfall the quarter needs to make up.

points.what: QTD revenue attainment is 87.4% against target, a gap of $52,211 with 6 weeks left in the quarter.
points.so_what: January and February month-to-date have both been behind target so far this quarter, so closing the gap needs stronger weeks than recently seen.

points.what: YTD revenue attainment is 87.4%, and the required weekly run-rate to hit the full-year target is $76,671 versus a current 8-week run-rate of $51,543.
points.so_what: At the current pace the full-year revenue target is out of reach.

points.what: APAC orders fell 6.5% week over week, contributing -22 orders, 48.9% of the week's total order decline.
points.so_what: APAC was the single largest regional driver of the order shortfall against target this week.

points.what: LATAM orders fell 21.4% week over week, also contributing -22 orders, 48.9% of the decline despite being the smallest region.
points.so_what: The decline was spread across two regions rather than concentrated in the largest one.

points.what: Organic traffic orders fell 25.9% week over week, contributing -29 orders, 64.4% of the total order decline, the largest driver by traffic source.
points.so_what: Organic was the single biggest source of this week's order shortfall, more than Search which holds most of the order share.

points.what: AOV fell 4.7% week over week to $83.71 and 5.5% year over year.
points.so_what: AOV falling alongside orders means the revenue miss this week came from both fewer orders and smaller baskets.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell 1.3 pp week over week to 14.8%, a notable improvement, and is down 0.6 pp year over year.
points.so_what: With each 1 pp of cancellation worth $583 in revenue, this week's improvement helped limit the revenue shortfall against target.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of Jan 26 rose 2.2 pp week over week and 2.2 pp year over year to 11.6%.
points.so_what: Rising returns alongside falling AOV point to weaker order quality this period.

points.what: New signups were flat week over week at 223 but down 3.9% year over year, while orders grew 44.4% year over year.
points.so_what: This week's order growth is not coming from new customer accounts on a year-over-year basis.

checks.name: 14-Day Return Rate names its mature week
anomaly flag acknowledged in the summary
sentences at most 30 words and 4 numbers
each slot only covers its allowed KPIs
